name: Plastic Engineering Company of Tulsa, Inc.
old_description: We are a privately-held corporation continuously owned by the same family dating back to our inception in 1945. Since 1970 the company has been located a block east of Sheridan on 44th Street. We serve as both a distribution center and a custom fabrication facility.
about:
Plastic Engineering Company of Tulsa, Inc. was founded in 1945 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and has remained under continuous family ownership since its inception. The company moved to its current location, a block east of Sheridan on 44th Street, in 1970.

The firm operates as both a distribution center and a custom fabrication facility, offering custom manufacturing services that range from single parts to large production runs. Its capabilities span product conception through production, packaging, and shipping of finished goods.

The company serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries, leveraging more than seven decades of manufacturing experience to adapt to changing marketplace needs. Its willingness to customize has resulted in a wide variety of product lines, though specific industry sectors are not detailed in available materials. The company's website functions as a purchasing guide for current and prospective customers, reflecting the breadth of its capabilities.

Plastic Engineering emphasizes its long-tenured workforce as the cornerstone of its success and highlights its ability to embrace new concepts and innovations while maintaining a focus on quality from concept to market-ready commodity. The firm's goal is to create a quality product by working with customers from product conception through production, culminating in the packaging and shipping of a marketable commodity.
